P.name: Royal Privilege
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Qiyana's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|ability|basic abilities}} deal {{pp|15 + (83-15)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=physical damage}} {{as|(+ 25% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} {{as|'''additional''' physical damage|physical damage}}.

This effect cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds.
P.description2: Gathering an {{as|Element|buzzword}} with ''{{ai|Terrashape|Qiyana}}'' resets ''Royal Privilege's'' per-target {{sti|cooldown}} for enemies affected by ''Royal Privilege'' using a different {{as|Element|buzzword}} (or no {{as|Element|buzzword}}).

Q.name: Edge of Ixtal
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Qiyana''' slashes forward in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies in a line, reduced to 75% damage against targets beyond the first. ''Edge of Ixtal'' deals 160% damage against {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|80 to 200}} {{as|(+ 90% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Reduced Damage|{{ap|80*0.75 to 200*0.75}} {{as|(+ {{ap|90*0.75}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description2: Gathering an {{as|Element|buzzword}} with ''{{ai|Terrashape|Qiyana}}'' resets ''Edge of Ixtal's'' {{sti|cooldown}} and upgrades it into ''Elemental Wrath''.
Q.description3: If cast during ''{{ais|Audacity|Qiyana}}'' dash towards an enemy {{tip|champion}} and the target is within 150 units of '''Qiyana''' at the end of the dash, ''Edge of Ixtal'' will autonomously aim at the target.

Q.name: Elemental Wrath
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Qiyana''' hurls her blade in the target direction that blasts in a line upon hitting an enemy or maximum range, consuming the current {{as|Element|buzzword}} to empower the blade with an additional effect.
Q.description2: Enemies hit are dealt ''Edge of Ixtal's'' damage, reduced to 75% against subsequent enemies beyond the closest. ''Elemental Wrath'' deals 160% damage against {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|80 to 200}} {{as|(+ 90% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Reduced Damage|{{ap|80*0.75 to 200*0.75}} {{as|(+ {{ap|90*0.75}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description3: {{sbc|{{as|Brush}}:}} The blade creates a grass field around '''Qiyana''' that lasts for up to 3 seconds, granting her {{tip|invisibility}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|20% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} until she attacks, casts an ability other than ''{{ai|Terrashape|Qiyana}}'', or exits the field.
Q.description4: {{sbc|{{as|River}}:}} The blast {{tip|root|roots}} enemies hit for {{fd|0.5}} seconds, then {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 20% for 1 second.
Q.description5: {{sbc|{{as|Terrain}}:}} The blast deals {{ccs|60% increased damage|physical}} against enemies below {{as|50% of their '''maximum''' health}}. Subsequent targets beyond the closest that are below the threshold take 35% increased damage instead.

W.name: Terrashape
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} While holding an {{as|Element|buzzword}}, '''Qiyana''' gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, {{sti|range|25 '''bonus''' attack range}} and {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} on her basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} and basic abilities. While [[Combat status|out-of-combat]] and moving near the {{as|Element|buzzword}} currently being held, she gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Qiyana''' {{tip|dashes}} up to 300 units towards the target location to gather the {{as|Element|buzzword}} of the nearest {{cci|Terrashape Brush.png}} {{sbc|{{as|Brush}}}}, {{cci|Terrashape River.png}} {{sbc|{{as|River}}}} or {{cci|Terrashape Rock.png}} {{sbc|{{as|Terrain}}}} she targeted.
W.description3: ''A target Element is required to cast this ability''.
W.description4: Once ''Terrashape'' has been learned, '''Qiyana''' is automatically given the {{cci|Terrashape Rock.png}} {{sbc|{{as|Terrain}}}} element upon [[Death|respawning]].
W.description5: '''''Qiyana''' can cast any of her abilities during the dash.''

E.name: Audacity
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Qiyana''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} a fixed distance in the direction of the target enemy. If they are in range upon arrival, she deals {{as|physical damage}}.
E.description2: '''''Qiyana''' can cast any of her abilities during the dash.''

R.name: Supreme Display of Talent
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Qiyana''' sweeps a windblast in the target direction that {{tip|airborne|knocks back}} enemies hit by {{tt|375 units|estimated}}, though not through terrain, and stops upon hitting {{sbc|{{as|Terrain}}}}.
R.description2: The windblast creates a cascading shockwave across any {{sbc|{{as|River}}}} or {{sbc|{{as|Brush}}}} it passes through, as well as around the borders of {{sbc|{{as|Terrain}}}} it reaches, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{pp|changedisplay=true|type=proximity|0.5;1|0;X}} seconds, and briefly granting {{tip|sight}} of the area along its path. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.
R.leveling2:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|100 to 300 3}} {{as|(+ 125% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 10% of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
{{st|Capped Monster Health Damage|{{ap|500 to 1000 3}} {{as|(+ 125% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
